preconditions.description: The number of students is at least 1 and at most 1000.
The number of buses is at least 1 and at most 10^9.
The number of days is at least 1 and at most 1000.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output.splitlines() and len(output.splitlines()) == d and all(len(line.split()) == n for line in output.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a valid arrangement of students in buses for each day. If not -1, it consists of d lines, each with n integers representing the bus number for each student on that day.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or all(all(1 <= int(bus) <= k for bus in line.split()) for line in output.splitlines() if line != '-1')
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, each bus number is between 1 and k, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or not any(line.count(str(bus1)) == line.count(str(bus2)) == d for i, line in enumerate(output.splitlines()) for j, bus1 in enumerate(line.split()) for k, bus2 in enumerate(line.split()) if i != j and bus1 != bus2)
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, no two students share the same bus for all d days.
